name: kernel
description: Local-first Oracle work coordination, safe agent routing, budget gates, and verification for Codex.

interface.longDescription: KERNEL maintains a file-based work board, discovers canonical project tasks, routes safe work through local and free providers, and records verification evidence for Oracle.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use KERNEL to inspect the canonical work board, select the next safe task, route it through the lowest-cost capable provider, and verify the result.
